topic: Comparing AI engine performance on documents
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical feasibility and comparison of various AI engines for processing internal documentation. One participant suggested building a knowledge base engine with a local database that could be connected to any engine. Another participant mentioned exploring hosting an open-source version locally, citing potential high costs associated with SaaS solutions. A concrete plan was proposed: setting up multiple instances (e.g., ChatGPT and AutoGPT) and feeding them the same set of documents for comparison.
decisions: Compare performance of ChatGPT and AutoGPT on a standardized document set.
action_items: Investigate deploying open-source AI versions locally to avoid high SaaS costs.
